hook: *₹10,000 crore* El Niño plan for Telangana's tanks
hook_b: *₹10,000 crore* El Niño plan for Telangana's tanks
tldr: The state's El Niño preparedness programme will be a highlight of the Telangana Climate Conclave at the Rising summit.

beats.what: Irrigation and Panchayat Raj departments will jointly rejuvenate tanks, streams and canals and expand rainwater harvesting.
beats.why: El Niño threatens drought; the plan aims at groundwater recharge and water security across rural Telangana.
beats.care: Water security in districts feeds into city supply worries; the works also aim to create lean-season jobs.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Minister Uttam Kumar Reddy asked that ICRISAT-backed climate models feature at the conclave.

cards.q: Is tank restoration the right first step for El Niño?

qs: How much of the work will reach tanks around Hyderabad?
How will ₹2,000 crore a month be funded?

facts.t: A list of *355 categories* of works was prepared for the El Niño employment drive.

viz.verdict: A plan; spending has not started yet.

watch: The action plan the Panchayat Raj department releases before Sankranti.
